tagline: Unbiased, vet-reviewed pet product guides & honest picks for Indian dogs and cats.

design_philosophy.archetype: Organic & Earthy meets High-End Editorial Publishing
design_philosophy.theme_mode: Light First (Warm Cream/Parchment base with high-contrast Charcoal typography and kinetic micro-accents)
aesthetic_rules: NO purple/indigo AI gradients (#7351B7 is forbidden).
NO generic centered cards or Bootstrap-style 3-column blandness.
Use warm creamy backgrounds, tactile 1px border lines, asymmetric magazine bento rhythm, and generous breathing room (2-3x typical spacing).
Real pet photography with spotlight treatment, warm rounded cards (rounded-2xl/rounded-3xl), soft multi-layer ambient drop-shadows.
Masked line-by-line typography reveal on hero load for editorial prestige.
Sticky navigation with Apple-style crystal glassmorphism (bg-amber-50/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-amber-200/50).
Slow editorial marquee ribbon with warm terracotta/sage tones.

typography.heading_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Cabinet Grotesk, or Fraunces (Editorial Warm Serif/Display)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete application inside /app/frontend using React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, and Framer Motion.
Implement both the Homepage and the dedicated in-depth Article Page ('Best Cat Food in India 2026') seamlessly switchable via the navigation bar and hero CTA buttons.
Follow the creamy warm aesthetic: background '#FAF7F2', charcoal text '#1C1917', vibrant coral orange '#EA580C' for buttons, and soft teal '#0D9488' for ratings and trust cues.
Include the interactive Pet Food Monthly Budget Calculator in ₹ (INR), which elevates the utility of the site for Indian pet parents.
Implement the live search modal and category filtering for high engagement.
Include complete data for Indian cat and dog foods (Farmina N&D, Royal Canin, Whiskas, Drools Focus, Arden Grange, Orijen, Sheba, Purepet) with accurate ₹ pricing and AAFCO / vet-backed analysis.
Ensure all testing attributes with data-testid match the manifest above.
Ensure responsive mobile-first behavior with clear navigation and non-cramped layouts.
